GUIDANCE: Q3 FY2026 ~$29.4B revenue (+84% YoY), AI semi ~$16.0B (+>200% YoY), non-GAAP op margin ~67%. DROP: Stock ~-21% off ATH/52w high of $495.00 (set June 3, 2026, the earnings day). Classified fear_rotation: the pullback came DESPITE a strong Q2 beat (rev +48%, AI +143%) and a strong Q3 guide; selloff driven by soft infrastructure-software/VMware results and the full-year AI outlook being held UNCHANGED vs raised buy-side expectations (expectations reset / profit-taking after a large run), not by deteriorating fundamentals, which are accelerating.
